deviations.why: libxml2's 2017 Python bindings do not compile against the base image's Python 3.11 headers
deviations.rationale: the bindings are unreachable from the fuzz target; modern OSS-Fuzz builds libxml2 the same way

deviations.why: the modern base image ships zlib headers that the ARVO image lacked, so configure would enable compression the historical link line cannot satisfy
deviations.rationale: RESTORES the historical configuration rather than changing it: the ARVO image has no zlib.h/lzma.h and `nm -u` on its binary shows zero inflate/lzma symbols
